Adwarp can now pause, resume and archive a single LinkedIn ad, without touching the rest of its ad group.

### What changed

- New MCP tool `update_ad` sets an ad's status to `PAUSED`, `ACTIVE` or `ARCHIVED`. It accepts a numeric creative id or a full `urn:li:sponsoredCreative`, and it works on the hosted endpoint too. The status is required, so leaving it out can never switch an ad on.
- New CLI commands `adwarp ad pause <creativeId>`, `adwarp ad resume <creativeId>` and `adwarp ad archive <creativeId>`. Each previews the change and sends it only with `--apply`. Resume says that it starts spend, and warns when the ad is still a draft.
- The change journal now records ads by their numeric id, so `adwarp lift creative <id>` finds ad creations and status changes.
- `docs/tools.json` lists 36 tools, 27 of them on the hosted endpoint.

Setting an ad to `ACTIVE` starts spend, so your assistant does it only when you explicitly ask. An active ad serves only while its ad group is active, and LinkedIn refuses to pause an ad that is still in review.
